description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeRuntime component, testing trigger trimming, content detection after triggers, and wake word gating logic.

methods.name: trims after trigger keeps post speech
methods.description: Tests that the trigger trimming correctly retains the post-trigger speech.

methods.name: trims after trigger returns original when no trigger
methods.description: Tests that no trimming occurs when no trigger is present.

methods.name: trims after first matching trigger
methods.description: Tests trimming with multiple triggers, ensuring the first match is used.

methods.name: has content after trigger false when only trigger
methods.description: Checks that the system correctly identifies no content after trigger when only trigger is present.

methods.name: has content after trigger true when speech continues
methods.description: Checks that the system detects content following the trigger.

methods.name: trims after chinese trigger keeps post speech
methods.description: Verifies trimming works with Chinese triggers.

methods.name: trims after trigger handles width insensitive forms
methods.description: Ensures trimming functions correctly with full-width characters.

methods.name: gate requires gap between trigger and command
methods.description: Tests that the wake word gate enforces minimum gap between trigger and command.

methods.name: gate accepts gap and extracts command
methods.description: Checks that the gate allows commands when the gap condition is met.

methods.name: gate command text handles foreign string ranges
methods.description: Verifies command extraction handles ranges from foreign strings correctly.
